results.title: Arkade Developers adds 4 cluster redevelopment projects in Western Mumbai
results.description: Arkade Developers said that it has added four redevelopment projects across Malad West, Kandivali West, Kandivali East and Borivali West, covering a combined area of around 45,204 square meters or 11.17 acres.

results.title: India should not rush to finalise US trade deal, says EAC-PM member Sanjeev Sanyal
results.description: Sanjeev Sanyal said prolonged trade agreements require careful scrutiny, particularly as negotiations involve sensitive domestic sectors and uncertain US tariff policies.
